pokemon-2026.name: Pokémon TCG cards
pokemon-2026.description: Fifteen Pokémon TCG promo cards, two in every Happy Meal. Seven are holo foils, including Pikachu, Mimikyu and Jirachi. The main price is for raw single cards; graded copies are priced separately.

spongebob-onepiece-2026.description: Fifteen crossover figures that pair Bikini Bottom with the One Piece cast, from SpongeBob × Luffy and Patrick × Zoro to Mermaid Man × Garp. SpongeBob appears twice, with Luffy and with Gear 5 Luffy.

groups.description: Every Pokémon Happy Meal comes with one mini box toy and two TCG promo cards. The 15 mini boxes, one Pokémon each, double as bag charms. Seven of the 15 cards are holo foils, including Pikachu, Mimikyu and Jirachi.
